scripts.build: pnpm --filter resultar build && pnpm --filter resultar-lint build && pnpm --filter resultar-tsgo build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter resultar check && pnpm --filter resultar-lint check && pnpm --filter resultar-tsgo check
scripts.check:full: pnpm --filter resultar check:full && pnpm --filter resultar-lint check && pnpm --filter resultar-tsgo check
scripts.smoke:package: pnpm --filter resultar smoke:package && pnpm --filter resultar-lint smoke:package && pnpm --filter resultar-tsgo smoke:package
